candidates.buyer: Small private veterinary practices and clinics (farm-animal and equine vets), also vet pharmacies
candidates.category: 9. Veterinary practices and veterinary medicine sellers
candidates.existing: Competitor search (veterinarski softver evidencija liječenja eVeterinar): only generic booking/clinic software (Anolla) and foreign vendors; no Croatian product found that integrates with the new state database. The state may provide its own entry UI (unchecked).
candidates.name: Veterinary treatment e-recording and antimicrobial/equine data for vet practices (new vet medicines law)
candidates.trigger: Zakon o veterinarskim lijekovima i veterinarskim medicinskim proizvodima (NN 69/2026, in force 29 July 2026): vets must enter vaccination and treatment data into the Ministry's national electronic database, food-producing animals from 1 Jan 2027, non-food animals from 1 Jan 2029; implements EU rules on antimicrobial sales/use data and equine treatment records (Reg. 2019/6).
candidates.unchecked: Whether the state database offers an API or only a web form; practice-management vendors (e.g. local vet software) may add integration; number of practices; exact data fields and whether farmers also record; the Ministry implementing ordinances still to be issued; NN text itself not read (only zakon.hr summary).

candidates.buyer: Small taxi operators (sole traders and small firms with a few cars), plus small platforms/dispatchers
candidates.category: 18. Transport operators: minibus, taxi, moto-taxi, small trucking and bus fleets
candidates.existing: Competitor search (program za taksi prijevoznike evidencija vozača kartica): found no taxi compliance software; only the state e-Taksi driver-card service (AKD) and municipal forms. Platforms like Bolt/Uber handle their own drivers.
candidates.name: Taxi operator compliance kit under 2026 taxi amendments (per-vehicle permits, driver-card QR checks, vehicle register, change reporting)
candidates.trigger: Zakon o izmjenama i dopunama Zakona o prijevozu u cestovnom prometu (NN 77/2026, in force 23 July 2026): permit per vehicle, special taxi plates, operator must continuously check driver card validity by QR, platform registers of operators/drivers/vehicles (6 months to comply), municipalities publish permits by 31 March 2027; municipal licence rules also demand a vehicle register and notice of changes within 8 days.
candidates.unchecked: No separate obligation on sole-trader operators confirmed; QR check may be done in a free state app; taxi operator count; Pravilnik on vehicles still pending; whether most small operators work through platforms that already cover this.

candidates.buyer: Authorised exchange offices (ovlašteni mjenjači), mostly small craft businesses and small firms
candidates.category: 19. Market traders, street vendors, money changers
candidates.existing: Existing certified programmes already used for the 2016 rules (teb.hr 2016 note on the protected programme); no competitor search run, so vendors unknown.
candidates.name: Certified exchange-office programme and quarterly HNB reporting under the new Foreign Exchange Act
candidates.trigger: Zakon o deviznom poslovanju in force 26 March 2026: all exchange transactions, reversals and cash balance changes recorded in an HNB-certified programme; quarterly report to HNB by the 10th of the following month; HNB bylaw on programme specs pending; new fee and card-exchange rules from 26 Dec 2026.
candidates.unchecked: Competitor search not run (budget); number of exchange offices; whether certified-programme vendors already dominate; HNB certification process cost and whether a solo founder could get certified.

candidates.buyer: Craft businesses buying scrap metal and other waste from individuals (trgovanje otpadom na malo)
candidates.evidence: Search snippet summarising the Pravilnik o gospodarenju otpadom (zakon.hr, narodne-novine.nn.hr links returned); no 2026 change found.
candidates.existing: Not searched; no competitor search run.
candidates.name: Retail scrap/waste buyer register kit: Očevidnik trgovaca otpadom, ownership statements and container labelling
candidates.trigger: Pravilnik o gospodarenju otpadom: entry in Očevidnik trgovaca otpadom, labelled container at the buying location, keep seller ownership statement or otkupni blok for 3 years.
candidates.unchecked: Whether the buyer group is distinct from K01 in practice; how many dealers; whether e-ONTO covers buying records; 2026 amendments (NN 51/26, 95/26) not read.

candidates.buyer: Small associations (sports clubs, hunters, fire brigades, cultural societies) with volunteer treasurers
candidates.category: 17. Community and religious bodies: associations, charities, halal and kosher supervision
candidates.existing: Not searched; accounting firms and nonprofit accounting software likely exist.

candidates.trigger: Zakon o financijskom poslovanju i računovodstvu neprofitnih organizacija (annual financial reports, Registar neprofitnih organizacija); Registar stvarnih vlasnika entries for associations (Pravilnik amended NN 51/26); municipal PROR-POT public funds reports (2025 deadline 30 Jan 2026).
candidates.unchecked: Competitor search not run; willingness to pay; much of the work is done by accounting services; no new law found.

candidates.buyer: Small municipalities and municipal utility companies running cemeteries; possibly parish managers

candidates.trigger: Zakon o grobljima (NN 78/25, 80/25, in force 17 May 2025); local Odluke o grobljima 2026 require the manager to keep a grobni očevidnik and register of the deceased.
candidates.unchecked: Buyers are public bodies (procurement, slow); existing municipal GIS/cemetery software not checked; funeral director rules not found.

candidates.buyer: Small building managers (upravitelji zgrada) and owners of older lifts

candidates.existing: Not searched; inspection bodies and maintenance firms likely track dates themselves.
candidates.name: Lift owner inspection and maintenance-book tracker for small building managers
candidates.trigger: Pravilnik o sigurnosti dizala u uporabi (NN 5/2019): periodic and extraordinary inspections by authorised organisation, safety upgrade for lifts installed before 31 March 2006, entries in maintenance book.
candidates.unchecked: Frequency of inspection, who is legally the obligated party in practice, and whether boiler/pressure vessel rules add volume; no 2026 change found.

candidates.existing: Not searched; driving-school management software likely exists.

candidates.trigger: Pravilnik o osposobljavanju kandidata za vozače (consolidated to NN 54/26): records and enrolment documents, instructor/lecturer permits tracked, electronic report of condition changes by next day to authorised organisation.

candidates.unchecked: One-off alignment rather than recurring duty; very few buyers; likely better folded into the vet practice candidate.

coverage.category: 1. Household employers: domestic workers, live-in carers, nannies
coverage.found: Nothing new beyond existing rules: employer-natural-person registers worker via M-1P/M-11P before work starts, termination within 24h (teb.hr, 2015 source, dated). No 2026 change found. Dadilje (nanny) law, Zakon o dadiljama, is current (NN 66/26 consolidated) with family-centre supervision of craft nanny businesses; thin.

coverage.category: 2. Scrap-metal dealers
coverage.found: Retail waste traders (trgovanje otpadom na malo) must be in Očevidnik trgovaca otpadom, keep labelled containers at the buying site, and keep the seller's ownership statement (izjava o vlasništvu / otkupni blok) 3 years (Pravilnik o gospodarenju otpadom). No 2026 change confirmed. Listed as candidate related to K01.

coverage.category: 3. Second-hand dealers and pawnbrokers
coverage.found: Search found no specific 2026 Croatian rule for second-hand dealers; an HGK deck on the 2017 AML law says goods traders are not AML obliged persons (needs recheck against the NN 54/26 consolidated AML law). Cash limit rule exists. Nothing candidate-worthy found.

coverage.category: 4. Gold and jewellery buyers
coverage.found: No Croatia-specific obligation found beyond AML/cash-limit generalities; not confirmed whether gold buyers are obliged under the AML law (unverified).

coverage.category: 5. Used car parts and vehicle dismantlers
coverage.found: ELV system works through authorised treatment operators issuing deregistration certificates; the ELV ordinance and any dismantler used-parts register were not found. Nothing new.

coverage.category: 6. Livestock traders, markets and animal transport
coverage.found: Animal transport authorisations are issued by the Ministry (up to 5 years, Reg. 1/2005) and vehicle approvals for long journeys by the State Inspectorate; published lists of carriers. No trader register or 2026 identification change found; HAPIH not confirmed.

coverage.category: 7. Small abattoirs and butchers
coverage.found: Pravilnik o registraciji i odobravanju objekata (consolidated to NN 47/26/53/26): on-farm registration, 30-day change notification, 8-day deletion, small-slaughterhouse thresholds (<1000 livestock units), short-supply-chain sales rules. Nothing new in 2026 confirmed; too thin for a candidate.

coverage.category: 8. Beekeepers
coverage.found: Nothing new beyond K03 (not searched, known).

coverage.category: 9. Veterinary practices and veterinary medicine sellers
coverage.found: Big find: new Zakon o veterinarskim lijekovima i veterinarskim medicinskim proizvodima (NN 69/2026, in force 29 July 2026) creates a national electronic database for veterinary medicine use; vets must enter vaccination and treatment data, mandatory for food-producing animals from 1 Jan 2027 and for non-food animals from 1 Jan 2029; antimicrobial sales/use data collection and equine treatment records implemented; online sale only by approved vet pharmacies in a special section of the Upisnik veterinarskih ljekarni (prescription medicines banned online), existing online pharmacies to align within 30 days, retail vet pharmacies within 6 months.

coverage.category: 10. Well drillers and water abstraction
coverage.found: Concession (private) or water permit needed beyond general use; Hrvatske vode supervises. No 2026 small-user reporting rule found; an old exemption for irrigation up to 1 ha from own wells may be outdated (unverified). Nothing candidate-worthy.

coverage.category: 11. Septic, sanitation and waste haulers
coverage.found: No search spent; waste carriers are covered by known K01.

coverage.category: 12. Lift, boiler and pressure-equipment owners and inspectors
coverage.found: Pravilnik o sigurnosti dizala u uporabi (NN 5/2019): owners of lifts installed before 31 March 2006 must upgrade safety at next periodic inspection by an authorised body; extraordinary inspections recorded in the lift maintenance book. Boiler/pressure equipment rules not found. Buyer is mostly building managers; weak.

coverage.category: 13. Small water systems
coverage.found: Budget; only a passing note that Hrvatske vode tracks drinking-water sources above 10 m3/day or 50 people (unverified).

coverage.category: 14. Pesticide and fertiliser dealers and applicators
coverage.found: Nothing new beyond K02 (not searched, known).

coverage.category: 15. Labour contractors and recruitment agencies
coverage.found: One search returned mostly Serbian/Montenegrin/BiH material; for Croatia only the 2025 Foreigners Act amendments (HZZ opinion conditions) surfaced. Croatia agency-work rules not verified.

coverage.category: 16. Cemeteries, burial societies and funeral services
coverage.found: New Zakon o grobljima (NN 78/25, 80/25, in force 17 May 2025); municipalities adopted new local Odluke o grobljima in 2026 (Kaptol, Gračac, Garešnica, Hrvatska Kostajnica) requiring the manager to keep a grobni očevidnik and register of the deceased. Managers are mostly municipal utilities, so buyer is semi-public; funeral director licensing not found.

coverage.category: 17. Community and religious bodies: associations, charities, halal and kosher supervision
coverage.found: Associations: Zakon o financijskom poslovanju i računovodstvu neprofitnih organizacija (annual reports, Registar neprofitnih organizacija), Registar stvarnih vlasnika for associations (Pravilnik amended NN 51/26: representatives from OIB data count as beneficial owners; state/local-founded bodies exempt), municipal PROR-POT public-funds reports. No new law on associations found. Halal/kosher not searched.

coverage.category: 18. Transport operators: minibus, taxi, moto-taxi, small trucking and bus fleets
coverage.found: Zakon o izmjenama i dopunama Zakona o prijevozu u cestovnom prometu (NN 77/2026, in force 23 July 2026): permit per individual vehicle, special taxi plates, operator must continuously check driver card validity by QR, app price/route display, platform registers of operators/drivers/vehicles within 6 months, municipalities publish permits by 31 March 2027, tougher fines; ministry may set prices by ordinance; vehicle ordinance changes pending. Bus/minibus/trucking not searched.

coverage.category: 19. Market traders, street vendors, money changers
coverage.found: Money changers only: new Zakon o deviznom poslovanju in force 26 March 2026; every exchange transaction and cash balance change must be recorded in an HNB-certified programme, HNB bylaw on programme specs and report formats pending, quarterly report to HNB by the 10th of the following month, no bank contract needed any more, new fee rule and card-based exchange from 26 Dec 2026. Market traders and street vendors not searched.

coverage.category: 20. Small licensed premises with inspections: tattoo studios, driving schools, childminders and nurseries, small food producers, hunting outfitters
coverage.found: Driving schools: Pravilnik o osposobljavanju kandidata za vozače (consolidated to NN 54/26) requires records, enrolment documents, and electronic reporting of condition changes to the authorised organisation by the next day; no new 2026 rule found. Dadilje: Zakon o dadiljama current. Private kindergartens: only statistics found (342 private-founder units). Tattoo and hunting not searched; small food producers covered under 7.
